sessionStart.command: r=""; for c in "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$r" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$r/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" sessionStart || true; fi

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: [ "${FND_CTX_MONITOR:-1}" = "0" ] && [ "${FND_PROMPT_JSON:-1}" = "0" ] && exit 0; r=""; for c in "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$r" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$r/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" beforeSubmitPrompt || true; fi

subagentStart.command: r=""; for c in "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$r" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$r/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" subagentStart || true; fi

beforeShellExecution.command: r=""; for c in "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$r" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$r/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" beforeShellExecution; else m='The fnd commit guard could not be located or could not be run (hooks/cursor-shim.cjs was not found under CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or ~/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd, or node is not on PATH), so this git command is blocked rather than run unchecked. Re-install or repair the fnd plugin, make sure node is on PATH, then re-run the same command. Never bypass the repo git hooks (--no-verify, core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0) - they are quality gates.'; case "$(cat)" in *git*|*commit*|*push*|*merge*|*pull*) printf '{"permission":"deny","userMessage":"%s","agentMessage":"%s"}' "$m" "$m"; echo "fnd cursor hook: $m" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi

afterMCPExecution.command: [ "${FND_MCP_SLIM:-1}" = "0" ] && exit 0; r=""; for c in "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/fnd"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$r" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$r/hooks/cursor-shim.cjs" afterMCPExecution || true; fi
